name: Alturas Farmers Market
tagline: El Agave Azul · Fregoso Maria Gonzalez · 206 N Main St, Alturas, CA 96101
description: Alturas Farmers Market gathers local farms and food producers in 108 S Main St, CA. The market is a hub for seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from nearby growers. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
